subject: [PATCH v6 10/12] mm, swap: defer memcg_table allocation for physical swap clusters

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch optimizes memory allocation in the Linux kernel's swap management by deferring the allocation of a memcg table for physical swap clusters that only hold vswap backings. Such clusters are not accessed directly and their memcg records are stored on the vswap cluster's table instead. The patch allocates the memcg table eagerly only when it is known to be needed, which reduces memory waste and improves performance in vswap-heavy workloads.
